## Statistical results

| PC5 | 3.105 |

## Methods

Principal component analysis was run on 36 samples by 40 centered and scaled features. PC1 and PC2 explained 48.5% and 21.5% of the variance and are shown with 95% normal-theory confidence ellipses per group (drawn for groups of four samples or more). Group separation was tested with a one-way PERMANOVA on Euclidean distances (999 seeded random permutations): F = 27.97, p = 0.001. Drawn in R 4.4.1 with ggplot2 3.5.1.
